title: Oswald trained by ONI, part of private field intelligence operation

tellings.quote: actually trained by an office of naval intelligence wasn't CIA and he was in this thing called Operation [ __ ]

plain: Lee Harvey Oswald was trained not by the CIA but by the Office of Naval Intelligence, the Navy's own intelligence service, and took part in a private intelligence operation run out of New Orleans, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. He tells Michels this in an episode about JFK and UFOs, though the name of the operation is cut off in the recording, and he gives no source. If true, the man accused of killing Kennedy was tied to a Navy intelligence network rather than acting alone.
